model.description: Model to use for this agent
model.title: Model

mock_llm.description: Use a zero-latency mock model instead of a live LLM, to isolate instrumentation overhead from LLM sampling latency
mock_llm.title: Mock Llm

scaling_repetitions.description: If set, run the benchmark once per repetition count in this list (at the configured concurrency) to measure how latency/trace volume scale with transaction volume, instead of a single repetitions run
scaling_repetitions.title: Scaling Repetitions

scaling_concurrency.description: If set, run the benchmark once per concurrency level in this list (at the configured repetitions) to measure how latency/throughput scale with concurrent load, instead of a single concurrency run. Mutually exclusive with scaling_repetitions -- if both are set, scaling_concurrency takes precedence.
scaling_concurrency.title: Scaling Concurrency

forbidden_tools.description: Tools that must not be called
forbidden_tools.title: Forbidden Tools

domain.description: Target banking domain (e.g., front_office, mid_office, back_office)
domain.title: Domain

scenario.description: Specific scenario ID mapping to a concrete prompt
scenario.title: Scenario

institution.description: Post-Paper Extension (coding plan §11 'Additional banking workloads and deployment variants'): which seeded institution profile's data and policy parameters to run against (e.g. 'regional_credit_union'). Reuses the identical agents/tools/workflows -- only the seeded dataset and institution-specific thresholds (e.g. loan pre-approval's approval percentage) differ. Omit for the default institution.
institution.title: Institution

jaeger_endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint for the Jaeger exporter (only used when 'jaeger' is in export); defaults to http://localhost:4317
jaeger_endpoint.title: Jaeger Endpoint

grafana_endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint for the Grafana (Tempo) exporter (only used when 'grafana' is in export); defaults to http://localhost:4317
grafana_endpoint.title: Grafana Endpoint

grafana_auth_header.description: Full Authorization header value (e.g. 'Basic <base64>') for a Grafana Cloud managed OTLP endpoint; omit for an unauthenticated local Tempo collector
grafana_auth_header.title: Grafana Auth Header

langfuse_endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP traces endpoint for the Langfuse exporter (only used when 'langfuse' is in export); defaults to Langfuse Cloud
langfuse_endpoint.title: Langfuse Endpoint

langfuse_public_key.description: Langfuse project public key (used with langfuse_secret_key to build the required Basic auth header)
langfuse_public_key.title: Langfuse Public Key

langfuse_secret_key.description: Langfuse project secret key (used with langfuse_public_key to build the required Basic auth header)
langfuse_secret_key.title: Langfuse Secret Key

phoenix_endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint for the Phoenix exporter (only used when 'phoenix' is in export); defaults to http://localhost:4317
phoenix_endpoint.title: Phoenix Endpoint

phoenix_api_key.description: API key for a Phoenix Cloud instance; omit for an unauthenticated local 'phoenix serve' collector
phoenix_api_key.title: Phoenix Api Key

PolicyConfig.description:
A defense plugin to register alongside (and, in the hook dispatch
order, after) any configured attack -- Post-Paper Extension, coding
plan §11 "Security mechanism plugins". Same shape as AttackConfig
minus control_point/target: a PolicyPlugin (plugins/policies/__init__.py)
decides for itself, from ctx, whether a given dispatch is in scope,
the same way every attack plugin already does.
PolicyConfig.title: PolicyConfig

title: ExperimentConfig
